```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r load_rds}
# Define the RDS files produced by prepare_all_datasets.Rmd
datasets <- list(
  Mouse = "data/mouse_sr_correlations.rds",
  iNeuron = "data/neuron_sr_correlations.rds",
  LongBench = "data/longbench_sr_correlations.rds"
)
```

```{r fit_models}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Fit the mixed-effects models (per dataset), store them for downstream
# use (EMMs + coefficient heatmap), and save the model results to disk.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
models <- list()      # fitted model objects, keyed by dataset name
emm_list <- list()    # estimated marginal means
coef_list <- list()   # per-model coefficient tables (Estimate + p-value)
anova_list <- list()  # per-model Type III ANOVA tables

for (name in names(datasets)) {
  dat <- readRDS(datasets[[name]])

  # Prepare factors matching the Rmd
  dat$Technology <- as.factor(dat$Dataset)
  dat$Technology <- relevel(dat$Technology, ref = "ont")
  dat$Tool <- as.factor(dat$Tool)
  dat$Tool <- relevel(dat$Tool, ref = "bambu")
  dat$Normalization <- as.factor(dat$Normalization)
  dat$Normalization <- relevel(dat$Normalization, ref = "CPM")
  dat$Correlation_z <- atanh(dat$Correlation)

  # Fit mixed model
  model <- lmer(Correlation_z ~ Tool * Normalization + Tool * Technology + Normalization * Technology +
                 (1 | Sample), data = dat)

  # Store the fitted model for downstream chunks (heatmap, EMMs)
  models[[name]] <- model

  # Save the model object to disk
  saveRDS(model, file.path("data", paste0(name, "_lmer_model.rds")))

  # Coefficient table (Estimate, SE, t, p) for the combined heatmap
  cf <- as.data.frame(summary(model)$coefficients)
  cf$Term <- rownames(cf)
  cf$PValue <- cf[["Pr(>|t|)"]]
  cf$DatasetName <- name
  coef_list[[name]] <- cf

  # Type III ANOVA table
  ao <- as.data.frame(anova(model, type = 3))
  ao$Term <- rownames(ao)
  ao$DatasetName <- name
  anova_list[[name]] <- ao

  # Calculate EMMs
  emm <- emmeans(model, ~ Normalization * Technology)
  emm_df <- as.data.frame(emm)
  emm_df$DatasetName <- name

  emm_list[[name]] <- emm_df
}

# Combine EMMs
all_emms <- bind_rows(emm_list)

# Combine and save the model results
all_coefs_raw <- bind_rows(coef_list)
all_anova_raw <- bind_rows(anova_list)
write_csv(all_coefs_raw, file.path("data", "model_coefficients.csv"))
write_csv(all_anova_raw, file.path("data", "model_anova.csv"))
```

```{r clean_labels}
# Clean and rename factors for plotting
all_emms <- all_emms %>%
  mutate(
    Technology_Clean = case_when(
      Technology == "ont"      ~ "cDNA ONT",
      Technology == "kinnex"   ~ "Kinnex",
      Technology == "isoseq"   ~ "Iso-Seq",
      Technology == "ont_drna" ~ "dRNA ONT",
      TRUE                     ~ as.character(Technology)
    ),
    Technology_Clean = factor(Technology_Clean, levels = c("cDNA ONT", "Kinnex", "Iso-Seq", "dRNA ONT")),
    Normalization_Clean = case_when(
      Normalization == "CPM"          ~ "CPM",
      Normalization == "cqn"          ~ "CQN",
      Normalization == "EDA"          ~ "EDAseq",
      Normalization == "ratio_counts" ~ "SMR",
      Normalization == "TPM"          ~ "TPM",
      TRUE                            ~ as.character(Normalization)
    ),
    Normalization_Clean = factor(Normalization_Clean, levels = c("CPM", "CQN", "EDAseq", "SMR", "TPM")),
    DatasetName = factor(DatasetName, levels = c("Mouse", "iNeuron", "LongBench"))
  )
```



```{r theme_and_colors}
# Define Nature theme
theme_nature <- function(base_size = 6.5, base_family = "sans") {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) +
    theme(
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_size),
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_size - 0.5, color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = base_size - 0.3),
      legend.text = element_text(size = base_size - 0.7),
      strip.text = element_text(size = base_size - 0.3, face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = base_size + 0.5, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.key.size = unit(3, "mm")
    )
}

# Exact color palette matched from paper_plots/fig1/fig1.Rmd
tech_colors <- c(
  "cDNA ONT" = "#D1B490",  # Muted Gold/Tan
  "Kinnex"   = "#e31c93",  # PacBio Pink/Magenta
  "Iso-Seq"   = "#EE7B30",  # Soft Orange
  "dRNA ONT" = "#56B4E9"   # Soft Blue
)

# Tech shapes
tech_shapes <- c(
  "cDNA ONT" = 16, # Circle
  "Kinnex"   = 17, # Triangle
  "Iso-Seq"   = 15, # Square
  "dRNA ONT" = 18  # Diamond
)
```



```{r plot1_cpm_tpm}
# ----------------- PLOT 1: Focused CPM vs TPM -----------------
# Filter for CPM and TPM
cpm_tpm_emms <- all_emms %>%
  filter(Normalization %in% c("CPM", "TPM")) %>%
  mutate(Normalization_Clean = factor(Normalization_Clean, levels = c("CPM", "TPM")))

p1 <- ggplot(cpm_tpm_emms, aes(x = Normalization_Clean, y = emmean, color = Technology_Clean, shape = Technology_Clean, group = Technology_Clean)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), width = 0.1, linewidth = 0.4, color = "black") +
  geom_point(size = 2.0, fill = "white", stroke = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ DatasetName, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = tech_colors, name = "Technology") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = tech_shapes, name = "Technology") +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "EMM",
    title = NULL
  ) +
  theme_nature()
```

```{r coefficient_heatmap}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Combined regression-coefficient heatmap across all three datasets.
# Rows = model terms, columns = dataset; cell fill = significance,
# text = coefficient Estimate. Uses the models fitted in `fit_models`.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

# Clean term names for display
clean_term <- function(term) {
  term <- gsub("^Toolflair$", "flair (vs. bambu)", term)
  term <- gsub("^Toolisoquant$", "isoquant (vs. bambu)", term)
  term <- gsub("^Toolkallisto$", "kallisto (vs. bambu)", term)
  term <- gsub("^Tooloarfish$", "oarfish (vs. bambu)", term)

  term <- gsub("^Normalizationcqn$", "cqn (vs. CPM)", term)
  term <- gsub("^NormalizationEDA$", "EDA (vs. CPM)", term)
  term <- gsub("^Normalizationratio_counts$", "SMR (vs. CPM)", term)
  term <- gsub("^NormalizationTPM$", "TPM (vs. CPM)", term)

  term <- gsub("^Technologyisoseq$", "Iso-Seq (vs. cDNA ONT)", term)
  term <- gsub("^Technologykinnex$", "Kinnex (vs. cDNA ONT)", term)
  term <- gsub("^Technologyont_drna$", "dRNA ONT (vs. cDNA ONT)", term)

  if (grepl(":", term)) {
    parts <- strsplit(term, ":")[[1]]
    clean_parts <- sapply(parts, function(p) {
      p <- gsub("^Tool", "", p)
      p <- gsub("^Normalization", "", p)
      p <- gsub("^Technology", "", p)
      if (p == "ratio_counts") p <- "SMR"
      if (p == "ont_drna") p <- "dRNA ONT"
      if (p == "isoseq") p <- "Iso-Seq"
      if (p == "kinnex") p <- "Kinnex"
      p
    })
    return(paste(clean_parts, collapse = " \u00D7 "))
  }
  return(term)
}

# Assign term type (grouping for facet_grid)
get_term_type <- function(term) {
  if (!grepl(":", term)) {
    if (grepl("^Tool", term)) return("Tool Effects")
    if (grepl("^Normalization", term)) return("Normalization Effects")
    if (grepl("^Technology", term)) return("Technology Effects")
    return("Main Effects")
  } else {
    parts <- strsplit(term, ":")[[1]]
    has_tool <- any(grepl("^Tool", parts))
    has_norm <- any(grepl("^Normalization", parts))
    has_tech <- any(grepl("^Technology", parts))

    if (has_tool && has_norm) return("Tool \u00D7 Normalization")
    if (has_tool && has_tech) return("Tool \u00D7 Technology")
    if (has_norm && has_tech) return("Normalization \u00D7 Technology")
    return("Interactions")
  }
}

# Build heatmap data from the saved coefficient table
all_coefs <- all_coefs_raw %>%
  filter(Term != "(Intercept)")

all_coefs$CleanTerm <- sapply(all_coefs$Term, clean_term)
all_coefs$TermType <- sapply(all_coefs$Term, get_term_type)

term_type_order <- c(
  "Tool Effects",
  "Normalization Effects",
  "Technology Effects",
  "Tool \u00D7 Normalization",
  "Tool \u00D7 Technology",
  "Normalization \u00D7 Technology"
)
all_coefs$TermType <- factor(all_coefs$TermType, levels = term_type_order)
all_coefs$DatasetName <- factor(all_coefs$DatasetName, levels = c("Mouse", "LongBench", "iNeuron"))

all_coefs <- all_coefs %>%
  mutate(
    PValCat = case_when(
      PValue < 0.05 & Estimate > 0 ~ "Significant (Positive)",
      PValue < 0.05 & Estimate < 0 ~ "Significant (Negative)",
      TRUE                         ~ "NS (p \u2265 0.05)"
    ),
    PValCat = factor(PValCat, levels = c("Significant (Positive)", "NS (p \u2265 0.05)", "Significant (Negative)"))
  )

# Expand to a complete grid so missing terms show as grey placeholders
all_combinations <- expand.grid(
  CleanTerm = unique(all_coefs$CleanTerm),
  DatasetName = c("Mouse", "LongBench", "iNeuron"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

term_details <- all_coefs %>% select(CleanTerm, TermType) %>% distinct()
all_combinations <- all_combinations %>% left_join(term_details, by = "CleanTerm")

heatmap_data <- all_combinations %>%
  left_join(all_coefs %>% select(CleanTerm, DatasetName, Estimate, PValue, PValCat), by = c("CleanTerm", "DatasetName"))

heatmap_data$DatasetName <- factor(heatmap_data$DatasetName, levels = c("Mouse", "LongBench", "iNeuron"))
heatmap_data$PValCat[is.na(heatmap_data$PValCat)] <- "NS (p \u2265 0.05)"

heatmap_data <- heatmap_data %>%
  mutate(
    EstimateText = ifelse(is.na(Estimate), "", sprintf("%.3f", Estimate))
  )

# Significance colors (Red = positive sig, Blue = negative sig, grey = NS)
colors_signif <- c(
  "Significant (Positive)" = "#DE2D26",
  "NS (p \u2265 0.05)"       = "#F0F0F0",
  "Significant (Negative)" = "#3182BD"
)

p_heatmap <- ggplot(heatmap_data, aes(x = DatasetName, y = CleanTerm, fill = PValCat)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = EstimateText), size = 1.8, color = "black") +
  facet_grid(TermType ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = colors_signif,
    name = "Significance",
    na.value = "#F0F0F0"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Dataset",
    y = "Regression Coefficient (Effect on Correlation)"
  ) +
  theme_nature() +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold", hjust = 0, size = 6.5),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 6.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 5.8),
    legend.key.size = unit(3, "mm")
  )
```


```{r export}
# Save publication functions
save_pub_r <- function(plot, filename, width_mm = 180, height_mm = 80, dpi = 600) {
  w <- width_mm / 25.4
  h <- height_mm / 25.4

  # Save PNG
  ggsave(file.path("plots", paste0(filename, ".png")), plot, width = w, height = h, dpi = 150)

  # Save SVG
  svglite::svglite(file.path("plots", paste0(filename, ".svg")), width = w, height = h)
  print(plot)
  dev.off()

  # Save PDF
  grDevices::cairo_pdf(file.path("plots", paste0(filename, ".pdf")), width = w, height = h, family = "sans")
  print(plot)
  dev.off()

  # Save TIFF
  ragg::agg_tiff(file.path("plots", paste0(filename, ".tiff")), width = w, height = h, units = "in", res = dpi)
  print(plot)
  dev.off()
}

# Export plots
save_pub_r(p1, "Supplementary_Figure_15", width_mm = 180, height_mm = 85)
save_pub_r(p2, "tpm_kinnex_interaction_focused", width_mm = 180, height_mm = 85)
save_pub_r(p3, "Supplementary_Figure_16", width_mm = 180, height_mm = 85)
save_pub_r(p_heatmap, "Supplementary_Figure_14", height_mm = 240)
```
